trends.name: Iran-US Energy War Escalation
trends.summary: Trump reportedly threatens to 'take the oil in Iran' amid escalating military conflict entering its fifth week, with Iran targeting critical infrastructure in Kuwait. Real-time sentiment signals this could trigger sustained global energy shortage within weeks, creating severe economic disruption. Oil prices surging with Brent crude heading for record monthly gains.

trends.name: Oil Price Shock & Market Selloff
trends.summary: Oil soaring amid Middle East conflict with no clear resolution path; U.S. stock futures sinking as investors face energy shortage scenario. Analysis suggests next few weeks are decisive for economy-wide impact. Markets are finding nowhere to hide as financial assets groan under geopolitical weight.

trends.name: Trump Military-Industrial Pivot
trends.summary: Trump administration reportedly redirecting U.S. military aid from Ukraine to Middle East operations, signaling major shift in foreign policy priorities. This represents significant policy reversal with implications for NATO support, defense contractor funding, and geopolitical alliances.

trends.name: North Korea Weapons Development
trends.summary: Kim Jong Un oversees ground test of high-thrust solid-fuel missile engine, escalating nuclear weapons capabilities. Adds to broader geopolitical instability and potential demand for U.S. defense spending.

trends.name: Middle East Military Escalation
trends.summary: Israeli forces raise flag over Syrian town in latest raid described as 'provocative act'; Iranian attacks on Bahraini industrial facilities (Alba Company) causing injuries. Regional tension spreading beyond Iran-U.S. bilateral conflict with broader implications for supply chains and energy infrastructure.

trends.name: Trump Stock Market Influence Waning
trends.summary: Analysis suggests sustained market declines indicate Trump's historical positive influence on equities has diminished. Investors losing confidence in ability to navigate geopolitical and policy uncertainty under his administration.

trends.name: AI Drug Development M&A Acceleration
trends.summary: Eli Lilly reaches $2.75B deal with Insilico to commercialize AI-developed pharmaceuticals globally. Signals major pharma bet on AI-generated drug pipelines with significant capital deployment implications.

trends.name: Labor Market Deterioration Signals
trends.summary: Weekend jobs for teenagers have vanished, confusing economists and bureaucrats. Indicates potential broader labor market weakness and consumer spending headwinds not yet reflected in headline employment data.

trends.name: Nike Turnaround Credibility Crisis
trends.summary: Nike stock at 9-year lows ahead of earnings with serious doubts emerging over turnaround strategy execution. Critical test for investor confidence in management's ability to revitalize brand amid competitive and operational challenges.

trends.name: Meta AI Research & Legal Setbacks
trends.summary: Meta facing court losses with potential negative implications for AI research capabilities and consumer safety obligations. Legal restrictions could slow AI development and increase compliance costs.

trends.name: Pakistan Hosts Iran-US Negotiations
trends.summary: Pakistan prepared to host U.S.-Iran talks in coming days; Trump simultaneously weighing ground troop deployment. Conflicting signals suggest uncertainty about administration's actual endgame, creating market volatility from lack of clear resolution pathway.

trends.name: Tax Refund & Policy Uncertainty
trends.summary: Not all taxpayers receiving larger refunds; results vary significantly based on policy changes. Creates consumer spending uncertainty and potential household cash flow implications for Q1-Q2 2026.
